review_candidates.title: Project Specialist - Greece
review_candidates.description: Europe Greece LE_0208-Grohe Hellas Ltd Employee Assignment Hybrid Full Time 7 September 2026 LIXIL, through its iconic brand GROHE, is a global leader in water and housing technology. With a strong presence in over 150 countries, we partner with architects, designers, investors, and developers to bring world-class bathroom and kitchen solutions to life. As we continue to grow our project and specification business in Greece, we are looking for a Project Specialist to join our team. This is a high-impact, relationship-driven role where you will shape the presence of GROHE across major hospitality and residential developments nationwide. About The Role As a Project Specialist, you will be the key link between GROHE and the professional community, ensuring our products are selected for high-profile projects across Greece. You will work closely with architects, specifiers, hotel owners, investors, and distributors, driving product specification and supporting the execution of major developments. The role is field-focused, with regular travel across Greece—including islands—and close collaboration with internal teams. You will join a small, supportive team, working alongside an experienced colleague with deep industry knowledge who will provide guidance and mentorship as needed. What You Will Do Business Development & Specification Strategy Identify and develop new business opportunities across Greece. Drive the specification process within architectural and consultancy firms. Ensure GROHE products are selected for hospitality, residential, and commercial projects. Execute localized project strategies aligned with broader sales objectives. Relationship Management & Networking Build and maintain strong relationships with architects, designers, investors, and project teams. Act as the primary point of contact for stakeholders in your territory. Strengthen partnerships with distributors and key decision-makers. Conduct regular visits to interior design studios and consultants to promote brand awareness. Joint Growth & Commercial Planning Develop joint business plans with customers and review performance regularly. Collaborate with Marketing, Product Management, and Customer Support to ensure seamless project execution. Data Intelligence & Reporting Serve as CRM lead, ensuring accurate and high-quality data entry. Maintain pipeline visibility and dashboard reporting. Provide monthly, quarterly, and annual forecasts. Track competitor activity and market trends, delivering insights to management. What You Bring Experience & Skills 3–5 years’ experience in project-based roles within hospitality, construction, interiors, or related sectors. Strong organisational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously. Experience in specification sales, project sales, or business development. A strong local network within the Greek architecture and real estate community. Excellent communication and presentation skills. Customer-focused mindset with a proactive, solution-oriented approach. Strong analytical skills and CRM discipline (Salesforce preferred). Ability to work autonomously while collaborating cross-functionally. Proficiency in Greek and English. Strong Microsoft Office and Google Suite skills. Nice to Have Experience working in a global matrix organisation. Prior exposure to CRM systems such as Salesforce. Personal Attributes Comfortable with frequent travel, including flights to Greek islands. Positive, kind, and approachable personality. Confidently engaging in commercial discussions and influencing stakeholders. Able to navigate complex customer environments without direct pricing authority. Why Join Us Opportunity to travel extensively across Greece and work on high-profile developments. Chance to expand and leverage an existing professional network. Work for a global market leader with strong brand recognition. Autonomy to implement ideas and shape local strategy. Clear progression opportunities within a growing team. Be part of a long-term strategic project pipeline, including major national developments.

review_candidates.description: Location Remote - Europe; Buenos Aires; London; Sao Paolo Employment Type Full time Location Type Remote Department Product OverviewApplication Meet Siena Siena is the The Agent of Record for CX, built for consumer brands like Spanx, FIGS, Brooklinen, and Grüns. It runs as a connected multi-agent stack on top of a shared intelligence layer: agents that sell, support, listen, handle social and voice across the entire customer journey, turning every conversation into signal you can act on. The team We are a small, fully distributed, global team. We have built leverage into how we work, which is what lets a team this size move at the speed we do. We hire athletes. Everyone here owns real outcomes, defaults to writing over meetings, communicates with directness, and acts the moment they see something worth acting on. Low ego, high standards, fast clock. If you want to set the bar rather than follow one, keep reading. The role As a Product Specialist at Siena, you become the resident expert on how our platform works end-to-end: how each agent behaves, and how they work together as one system. You own a defined product surface deeply, you diagnose it with authority, and you're the bridge between the customers using it and the PM shaping where it goes next. You're T-shaped. You know the whole platform end-to-end, and you go deep on one or two agents that become your own. You learn the product cold (prompt engineering, config, deployment), and then you put that knowledge to work across a range of product activities. This is a versatile, hands-on, product-minded role, not a ticket-closing one. You'll work a support queue, but the point isn't the queue, it's what it teaches you about how the product behaves in the real world. You're energized by the loop: learn the product cold, diagnose agent behavior, enable people to use it, spot the themes, feed product, repeat. If you've ever sat close to a product, noticed something the roadmap was missing, and pushed to change it, this role is built for you. It's for someone who's excited to work across a variety of product-related activities and wants to grow into product management, product marketing, deployment, or agent deployments. Who You Are Product-minded above all: you go outside your job description to champion change and influence what gets built You've taken themes across tickets or customer feedback and used them to push product or roadmap direction Genuinely curious about how things work under the hood, happy to roll up your sleeves. You don't see a support queue as beneath you A clear communicator who moves between technical and non-technical people without losing either AI-native: you use AI tools to do real work at scale, and you reach for new ones without being asked Based in EMEA or North America for strong timezone crossover with the team Bonus points if you've worked in e-commerce or DTC brands, social media or community management, or done hands-on CX at scale Nice to have, not required: hands-on with APIs, Shopify themes, prompt engineering, or user research What You'll Do You'll work closely with our product team and leadership across a variety of product-related activities, including but not limited to: Own a defined Siena product surface and become its resident expert Learn the platform cold: how the agents behave, how they work together, prompt engineering, config, deployment Diagnose agent behavior with authority: product, config, or customer setup Run the feedback loop to the PM: turn the patterns you see across customers into clear, prioritized signal that shapes the roadmap Own enablement: the docs, guides, and live-chat material that sit between too-technical and too-marketing Run webinars and demos, support sales, and do the market research the team needs Work the support queue on your surface, not as overflow, but as your direct line to how the product behaves Why Siena? Real ownership. You will own problems, not tasks, with the autonomy to solve them your way and the trust to do it without a manager in your inbox. Work that ships and matters. What you build reaches real consumer brands fast. A category we are creating. The Agent of Record is new ground, with unsolved problems and cutting-edge models, not a crowded field to compete in. A team that respects your judgment. Globally distributed, async-first, low bureaucracy. We hire adults and treat you like one. Great salary plus equity or stock grants. Own a piece of what you build. Learning budget. If you are growing, so are we. AI-fluency by default. Few places will push your work with production AI further or faster. Our values The people who thrive here are curious, customer-obsessed, and take ownership without being asked. They fix problems first and explain later. They're direct about feedback—both giving and receiving it—because they care more about getting things right than being polite. They maintain high standards while moving at startup speed, and they build real relationships with teammates because they know that's how great work gets done. When things get tough, they adapt and keep pushing forward. Our approach to AI The people who thrive here treat AI like a natural extension of themselves. They've built their own ecosystem of agents - some for research, others for debugging, writing, analysis, or writing code. They know which AI works best for what problem. Everyone gets premium accounts (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity Pro, Cursor, Lovable) plus a quarterly budget for new tools. But the magic happens in how we share knowledge. Demo days where someone shows off a clever workflows. Slack threads about which model handles a specific use case better. Learning from each other's AI workflows. At Siena, we’re not just looking for people who can do a job. We’re looking for people who want to break boundaries, create the future, and reshape industries. If that’s you, we look forward to your application. We use AI-assisted screening tools as part of our hiring process. All decisions are made by humans.
